title: Why dogs can't drink from Zion's Virgin River #Shorts
description:
On July 4, 2020, a dog died about an hour after playing in the Virgin River. Park scientists found cyanobacteria in the algae making a nerve toxin far above safe levels. Never let your dog drink from the river.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #Zion #DogSafety #NationalParks
